# Shopify Fix Guide — Ad-Leak-Engine [SEED: 2399]

## Tracking Infrastructure Restoration

This fix restores your Meta tracking infrastructure so Meta's algorithm receives accurate, deduplicated conversion data. Without it, your ad spend optimizes against incomplete signals — inflating CPA and suppressing ROAS.

### Implementation
Follow the code block provided alongside this guide. The exact location to paste the code is specified in the code block metadata.

### After Applying
- Allow 24–48 hours for Meta to re-optimize with the restored data stream.
- Monitor Meta Events Manager for incoming events and Event Match Quality.
- Verify deduplication by comparing browser events against server events.

### Business Impact
Restored tracking enables Meta's algorithm to optimize toward actual conversions rather than proxy signals. This typically reduces CPA by 15–30% within the first optimization cycle.


**Expected Outcome:** All 6 Shopify Customer Events fire server-side with deduplicated event_ids.

**Implementation Code:**
*Location: customer-events.js (Shopify Admin > Settings > Customer Events > Add custom pixel)*
```javascript
// Meta Pixel Customer Events - Ad-Leak-Engine [SEED: 2399]
// Location: Shopify Admin > Settings > Customer Events > Add custom pixel
analytics.subscribe("page_viewed", (event) => {
  fbq('track', 'PageView', {event_id: event.id});
});

analytics.subscribe("product_viewed", (event) => {
  fbq('track', 'ViewContent', {
    content_ids: [event.data.productVariant.id],
    content_type: 'product',
    value: event.data.productVariant.price.amount,
    currency: event.data.productVariant.price.currencyCode,
    event_id: event.id
  });
});

analytics.subscribe("product_added_to_cart", (event) => {
  fbq('track', 'AddToCart', {
    content_ids: [event.data.productVariant.id],
    content_type: 'product',
    value: event.data.productVariant.price.amount,
    currency: event.data.productVariant.price.currencyCode,
    event_id: event.id
  });
});

analytics.subscribe("checkout_started", (event) => {
  fbq('track', 'InitiateCheckout', {
    value: event.data.checkout.totalPrice.amount,
    currency: event.data.checkout.totalPrice.currencyCode,
    event_id: event.id
  });
});

analytics.subscribe("payment_info_submitted", (event) => {
  fbq('track', 'AddPaymentInfo', {
    value: event.data.checkout.totalPrice.amount,
    currency: event.data.checkout.totalPrice.currencyCode,
    event_id: event.id
  });
});

analytics.subscribe("checkout_completed", (event) => {
  fbq('track', 'Purchase', {
    value: event.data.checkout.totalPrice.amount,
    currency: event.data.checkout.totalPrice.currencyCode,
    content_ids: event.data.checkout.lineItems.map(item => item.id),
    num_items: event.data.checkout.lineItems.length,
    event_id: event.id
  });
});
```

**Verification Steps:**
1. Go to Shopify Admin > Settings > Customer Events
2. Click 'Add custom pixel' and paste the snippet
3. Confirm the pixel shows 'Connected' status
4. Place a test order and verify events appear in Meta Events Manager

## Site Performance & UX Optimization

This finding relates to your **landing page experience and site performance**. The fix below improves page speed, mobile usability, or conversion friction — all of which directly impact your Quality Score, CPM, and conversion rate.

### Implementation
Follow the code block provided alongside this guide. The exact file and location are specified in the code block metadata. If no code block is provided, the recommendation is a configuration or process change within your Shopify admin.

### Expected Impact
- Improved Core Web Vitals scores (LCP, FID, CLS)
- Reduced mobile bounce rate
- Higher conversion rate from paid traffic
- Lower effective CPA due to improved Quality Score

### Verification
After applying the fix, re-run your landing page through Google PageSpeed Insights or Chrome DevTools Lighthouse to confirm the improvement.



**Expected Outcome:** Improved mobile user experience, faster page load, and higher conversion rate from paid traffic.

**Implementation Code:**
*Location: base.css (Global stylesheet (Shopify Admin > Online Store > Themes > Edit Code > Assets))*
```css
/* Mobile Tap Target Fix — Ad-Leak-Engine [SEED: 2399] */
/* Location: Global stylesheet or theme CSS */
/* Ensures all interactive elements meet the 48px minimum touch target */

a, button, input[type="submit"], input[type="button"],
[role="button"], .btn, .button, select {
    min-height: 48px;
    min-width: 48px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
}

/* Prevent adjacent tap targets from overlapping */
a + a, button + button {
    margin-left: 8px;
}

/* Ensure form inputs are easily tappable on mobile */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    input, select, textarea {
        min-height: 48px;
        font-size: 16px; /* Prevents iOS zoom on focus */
    }
}

```

**Verification Steps:**
1. Apply the fix to your Shopify theme
2. Open your storefront on a mobile device or Chrome DevTools mobile emulation
3. Verify the fix is visible and functional
4. Run Google PageSpeed Insights to confirm improvement
